[LFCA.4.1] Bringing historical records back into working memory as
facts the rule can match.

| Name | Explanation | Depends on | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storage_hydrate_facts` | `call hydrate_facts schema=... window=... as=... retain=... [limit=...]` | `call` | keep the facts live with long TTLs instead; the facts plane has no other read. |
| `storage_hydrate_samples` | `call hydrate_samples entity=... field=... window=... as=... retain=... [limit=...]` | `call` | maintain the aggregate in an in-memory `series`, where the program's `series` capability is `true` ([LFCA.5.1]). |
